첼시 were ahead of 아스널 at the top of the Premier League with equal goal difference but with more goals scored; 맨체스터 유나이티드 were a point behind in third place. Birmingham remained fourth, while 풀럼 moved into the top five at the expense of 사우샘프턴. 레스터 시티 and 미들즈브러 propped up the Premier League after an upturn in fortunes for 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼; Leeds had slipped into the relegation zone as the mass sale of players to help pay off mounting debts took its toll on the field. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 were in eighth place, just below 맨체스터 시티. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were top of Division One, where 위건 애슬레틱 were playing for the first time in their history. 노리치 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드, 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 completed the top six. 입스위치 타운 were a single goal short of the play-off places.
